source: WQL, 陕西南路195号, 2018-06-10, CC BY-SA 4.0
registration: Present only the photographed run in front of No.195. The lights and piers are annotated independently on the 2018 photograph; the 2017 oblique photo has a different rail treatment and does not constrain the 2018 alignment.
depth_note: About 1.55 m in front of the west wall. Ground position along the sidewalk is partly covered by the public guardrail, tree and pole. A 0.7–2.5 m range gives plausible feet in the partially hidden band; the open-yard width is an estimate.
material: Grey blockwork piers; darker pebbled panels; light grey belt and cap; narrow dark forked fence with shallow scrolls; dark capped lanterns with pale lights.
